Detail records transfers gross per fund: Sales Tax (28,144) p12 + Community Development Agency (22,100) p13 = 50,244. After the add, detail gross out = 50,244 + 8,549 = 58,793 = gross governmental transfers out printed on p5 (28,144 + 22,100 + 8,549); the remaining 36,693 difference to the net 22,100 is the intra-governmental transfers in (8,549 + 28,144) netted in the Total column: different basis, not an error.
